about: Sunday edition: every game still to play. Injury news for the 4:00, Sunday-night and Monday games is from the final reports (Saturday for Monday night), gathered from team sites, NFL.com, SI, Yahoo and NBC; the 1:00 games carry Thursday's notes only, so check their inactives before using a pick. Spreads, totals and moneylines were refreshed Sunday; anytime TD prices are from Fri Oct 16 and yardage lines from Thu Oct 15, the latest the free price feeds have posted (no yardage lines yet for the late games). News is shown next to each pick but is not added to the Desk numbers (books move on it).
bar: Players ruled out are dimmed and dropped from the TD and Games tabs.

outs.r: knee; ruled out for Thursday at Denver
DT, Achilles; out for the season
Edge, knee; not expected back yet
RB, groin; ruled out for Monday
DE, calf/knee; ruled out for Monday
WR, hamstring; ruled out for Monday
ruled out by Mike McCarthy for Sunday at Tampa Bay; expected to miss a couple of weeks (ESPN)
ruled out for Tampa Bay after injuries in the Week 5 win over Indianapolis

Sam Darnold.n: Starts Thursday at Denver. The nflverse schedule lists Drew Lock, so the Desk overrides it with Darnold.

Drew Lock.n: Backup QB; right forearm, limited in practice, no game status on the final report.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba.n: Active; cleared from the ankle issue.

Drake Thomas.n: LB; ruled out (ankle). Tyrice Knight expected to start.

Patrick Surtain II.n: CB; ruled out (ankle), did not practice all week.

Talanoa Hufanga.n: S; ruled out (ankle), did not practice all week.

Jeremiyah Love.n: Ruled out (ankle) after missing practice all week.

Rashee Rice.n: Ruled out (hamstring); missed every practice this week.

Dont'e Thornton Jr..n: Ruled out (hamstring); practice window open but not activated.

Javon Hargrave.n: DT; ruptured Achilles in Week 5, out for the season.

Micah Parsons.n: Not expected to return this week (ACL rehab, per Schefter).

Deebo Samuel Sr..n: Ruled out for Monday (hamstring), hurt in Week 5.

KeAndre Lambert-Smith.n: Questionable (hamstring); needs activation from injured reserve.

Ladd McConkey.n: Off the injury report (foot); Harbaugh: "We'll see how it goes."

Patrick Mahomes.n: Full practices with a knee tag; no game status.

Brock Bowers.n: Off the injury report; no designation.

CeeDee Lamb.n: Thigh; full practice all three days, no game status.

Stefon Diggs.n: Questionable (hamstring) after limited Friday and Saturday practices; Dan Quinn "cautiously optimistic". Some outlets list him out.

Jeremy McNichols.n: Questionable (quad). With Croskey-Merritt out, the WAS backfield is thin.

Mike Evans.n: Questionable (ribs, Achilles); did not practice this week.

Trent McDuffie.n: CB; questionable (groin), held out Friday as a precaution (McVay).

Budda Baker.n: S; questionable (groin), did not practice Friday.

Lamar Jackson.n: Ruled out again (ankle); Tyler Huntley starts (NBC, CBS).

Michael Penix Jr..n: Ribs. Full participant Wednesday and took all first-team reps; Kevin Stefanski says he starts barring a setback.

David Montgomery.n: Groin; 'week-to-week' per DeMeco Ryans. Woody Marks is the likely starter.

TreVeyon Henderson.n: High-ankle sprain, reported likely to miss multiple weeks (Schefter), but limited in practice Wednesday. Rhamondre Stevenson leads the backfield if he sits.

Will Shipley.n: Partially torn plantar fascia; expected to miss multiple weeks.

Quinshon Judkins.n: Day to day (Todd Monken); the walking boot after Week 5 was described as precautionary.

Woody Marks.n: Likely HOU lead back with David Montgomery week-to-week.

Rhamondre Stevenson.n: NE lead back if TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) sits.

Roman Wilson.n: Ruled out for Sunday; expected to miss at least a couple of weeks (ESPN's Jeremy Fowler).

Saquon Barkley.n: One report lists him out with Jalen Hurts (IR); check PHI inactives.

sea-den: Inactives — SEA: QB Jalen Milroe (emergency 3rd), LB Drake Thomas, LB Chazz Surratt, RB Robert Henry Jr., WR Montorie Foster Jr., DT Brandon Pili, CB Avery Smith. RB Zach Charbonnet was ruled out earlier. Jaxon Smith-Njigba is active.
Inactives — DEN: CB Patrick Surtain II, S Talanoa Hufanga, QB Sam Ehlinger (emergency 3rd), Jordan Jackson, Tyler Onyedim, Dallen Bentley, Kage Casey. CB Riley Moss (ribs) is active.
Opened SEA -1.5 on the lookahead; heavy early money on Seattle pushed it to -2.5/-3 (ML -148). Total opened 41.5, now 40.5.
ari-la: ARI: RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) and safeties Wydett Williams Jr. and Andrew Wingard are out; Budda Baker (groin) and Zaven Collins (hip) are questionable after sitting Friday. LT Paris Johnson Jr., G Isaiah Adams and RB James Conner are on injured reserve.
LA: CB Trent McDuffie (groin) and S Kam Curl (ankle) are questionable; otherwise healthy.
Jacoby Brissett starts for ARI (292 yds, 3 TD vs Detroit in Week 5). Marvin Harrison Jr. was traded. ARI has lost four straight.
lac-kc: LAC: out are LT Joe Alt, S Derwin James, CB Donte Jackson, Kayode Awosika and WR Tre Harris; WR Brenen Thompson is doubtful. Ladd McConkey and Quentin Johnston came off the report.
KC: WR Rashee Rice (hamstring) and LT Josh Simmons (back) are out; CB L'Jarius Sneed is questionable. KC is off a bye.
Most books KC -8.5, total 42.5. The Chargers are 0-5 ATS this season (SI).
buf-lv: BUF: nobody ruled out; WR DJ Moore and WR Josh Palmer (shoulders), DL Ed Oliver (knee, expected to sit), DL TJ Sanders and CB Dee Alford are questionable. RT Spencer Brown is cleared.
LV: WR Dont'e Thornton Jr., TE Carter Runyon and DT Tonka Hemingway are out; G Trey Zuhn III is questionable. Brock Bowers has no designation.
BUF -5.5, total 53.5. BUF is 4-1 ATS and LV 4-1 ATS this season.
dal-gb: DAL: CB Cobie Durant and OT Drew Shelton are out; LB DeMarvion Overshown, CB Joey Porter Jr., DT L.T. Overton and CB Ameer Speed are questionable. CeeDee Lamb (thigh) practiced fully and has no status.

GB: Javon Hargrave (season), Jonathan Ford, Skyy Moore and Benjamin St-Juste are out; CB Brandon Cisse (hip) is questionable, with Carrington Valentine next up. Micah Parsons is not expected to play against his old team.
GB -1.5 (-118), total 52.5-53.5. Four of five Dallas games have gone over (FanDuel).
was-sf: Monday night. WAS: RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin), QB Marcus Mariota (knee), DE Charles Omenihu and LB Javontae Jean-Baptiste are out; WR Stefon Diggs (hamstring) is questionable, and Dan Quinn said to expect updates Monday.
SF: DE Nick Bosa, WR Deebo Samuel, LB Garret Wallow and S Marques Sigle are out; WR Mike Evans (ribs, Achilles) is questionable after not practicing.
SF -7.5, total 50.5-52.5. SF is unbeaten and 4-1 ATS; WAS is 1-3-1 after a 27-27 tie with the Giants.
bal-cle: Lamar Jackson (ankle) is a game-time question: optimism from Schefter and Rapoport, but he was not seen at Wednesday practice. Tyler Huntley started Week 5.
Browns RB Quinshon Judkins is day to day; WR KC Concepcion is in the concussion protocol.
car-phi: Philadelphia: Will Shipley (plantar fascia) is expected to miss multiple weeks; reports expect Saquon Barkley back before him.
chi-atl: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) was a full participant Wednesday and is expected to start.
Chicago: reports differ on whether Caleb Williams (hamstring) is ready; Tyson Bagent has started the last two games.
nyj-ne: New England: TreVeyon Henderson (high ankle) was limited Wednesday despite reports he would miss multiple weeks.
pit-tb: Pittsburgh: WRs Roman Wilson and Ben Skowronek are both out.
hou-jax: Houston: David Montgomery (groin) is week-to-week; Woody Marks steps in.
